derivation.staminaMaximum: 21 class + 6 Panther per echelon x echelon 1
derivation.speed: Beast Legs sets speed 6, then Panther +1
derivation.kitDamageBonus: A kit's melee damage bonus applies to abilities with BOTH the Melee and Weapon keywords. A kit signature ability's printed damage already includes its own kit's bonuses and must not receive them again. The ranged free strike never receives a melee damage bonus.
derivation.speedOrdering: Beast Legs SETS speed 6, then the kit speed bonus is added to that. A set-last implementation would wrongly yield 6.
derivation.windedRounding: Winded equals half the Stamina maximum; the rounding comes from the always-round-down rule.
derivation.emissionOrder: Skills, features and abilities are emitted in definition order: ancestry, culture, career, class, then the aspect's option grants, with ancestry abilities after the free strikes. The canonical Fury/Berserker/Mountain row in docs/character-derived-values.md section 4.1 is the shape to match. The stormwight builds also grant Aspect of the Wild and a kit signature ability; their exact position among the abilities is NOT asserted here and is confirmed on the first real run.

derivation.damageImmunities: Corruption Immunity grants corruption immunity equal to level + 2; at level 1 that is 3. It is a numeric immunity, not blanket immunity.
derivation.shadowmeld: Shadowmeld's final clause — if the surface is destroyed the ability ends and the hero takes 1d6 damage that cannot be reduced in any way — appears ONLY in the markdown body, not in the structured effects field of either the YAML frontmatter or the unified JSON. Any renderer that rebuilds text from structured effects silently drops it.
